method: Eight varying inputs, output parity checked before timing. 43 matched workloads; new cases cover five date formatters, YearMonth difference and both short-date toPlainDate conversions. ISO throughput only; all16 owned calendar packs and IANA records included. Reference temporal-polyfill1.0.7 basic uses FormatJS native DateTimeFormat with registered native en locale/number pack and owned IANA data. 1000 warmup +five samples x5000 calls; transition cases128 warmup +five x512. Separate TS/Rust and source/HBC processes. Final runs serialized after tests; one host, partial native namespace. Registration excluded from hot timings.

result.scope: Public Instant/PlainTime/ISO-date/PlainDateTime/zoned/Duration workloads; Rust ISO/Instant/PlainTime/calendar/timezone/Duration/plain/zoned arithmetic and string parser/date formatter/short-date JSON bridge optional, all16 calendars and IANA records bundled. JS retains object semantics, host and Intl integration. Reference temporal-polyfill 1.0.7 basic implementation. timeParse/timeAdd read nanosecond; timeRoundFormat includes formatting. Zoned cases include gaps/folds/half-hour and skipped-day changes. Transition cases use512 iterations and128 warmup. Not complete native Temporal or WASM comparison.
result.intlProvider: FormatJS native DateTimeFormat with registered en locale and owned IANA data
